criteria.built_1996_2000_rule: small freehold projects built 1996-2000 flagged 'needs_verification', NOT auto-excluded
criteria.leasehold_99_rule: 99-yr included if (a) TOP within 10 years AND under 100 units, OR (b) up to 500 units if some 3BR stacks exceed 1,110 sqft (e.g. Kovan Residences). For 99-yr units, report remaining lease and the (buyer age + remaining lease >= 95) check.
criteria.psf_cap_rule: reference cap only; listings over $1,700 psf are flagged 'cap exceeded', NOT excluded

data_quality.portal_access: PropertyGuru, 99.co, EdgeProp, SRX, PropNex, Homejourney, Nestia all returned HTTP 403 on direct automated fetch. Every figure below is triangulated from WebSearch result titles/snippets, not live portal filters.
data_quality.action_required: Re-verify each listing's current price, size, floor and availability with the agent before acting. Portal prices move within a day and units may already be under offer.
